messages:
kyle: FYI support hit a crash after the invokeEnvelope rollout. Their parser blew up when arguments arrived as a quoted JSON string.
jamie: paste the payload?
kyle: from the ticket:
```json
{"invokeEnvelope":{"tool":"search","arguments":"{\"q\":\"redwood inference docs\"}","meta":{"rid":"r42"}}}
```
marco: classic double-encoding. Let's add a tiny "defensive shims" section in /docs/guides/structured-output.md that covers: 1) defensive parsing snippets (py/ts/rust/java), 2) JSON Schema validation suggestion, 3) one-line regression test example.
tasha: editorial: use a single term across the section (recommend "invokeEnvelope") and add an H3 anchor `#compat-shims`. Also run the link-checker before merging.
jamie: python shim I'll add:
```py
import json

def normalize(env):
    a = env.get('arguments')
    if isinstance(a, str):
        try:
            return json.loads(a)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return {}
    return a or {}
```
marco: TS shim I added in the draft PR. I'll also include a tiny unit test showing normalized output.
kyle: unique ask: can we add a Rust example for backend partners that use actix? simple defensive parse with serde_json.
marco: good call. I'll add a Rust snippet plus a one-line Java example for enterprise SDKs. Keep all snippets intentionally small.
tasha: include a short schema example for `arguments` and recommend validating with a JSON Schema before applying adapters. Note: explicitly tell folks not to regex-extract JSON.
docs-bot: Draft PR 6123 opened by marco: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123 (status: draft). link-check pending.
marco: PR includes: new H3 `compat-shims`, py/ts/rust/java snippets, anchor, unit-test examples, and a tiny note about not assuming `tool_call` vs `invokeEnvelope` (we accept both in adapters).
jamie: I'll add a one-line smoke test to the docs repo so CI can catch regressions: sample prompt -> normalized JSON.
tasha: final checklist in PR description: 1) snippets across 4 langs present, 2) anchor + link-check green, 3) editorial pass, 4) eng-ml ack on parsing guidance. I'll review after link-check.
kyle: I'll send the support workaround reply pointing to the new docs section once merged. Closing when PR is live. :white_check_mark:
